verdict.rationale: Rollbar explicitly tracks which People (users) are affected by each error (rollbar-docs-20/39), giving a per-item user-impact metric, and pricing/session-replay references confirm session-level tracking exists (rollbar-docs-21/40, rollbar-gh-3). However, there is no direct evidence of a unified 'affected users + affected sessions' metric surfaced on each Item for blast-radius-based prioritization, nor of sorting/filtering by this metric. Missing for 10: explicit item-level 'affected users/sessions count' UI documentation, evidence of sorting/prioritizing items by this metric rather than raw occurrence count.
